verdicts.reason: Same correct economics; Output 2 adds a checked before/after profit forecast, a cleaner scale/hold/trim ladder and the prepaid lever, while Output 1 leans on a fudged 86% target.
Output 1 has a tighter $38 ceiling with a Shopify-verified day-30 test, a tracking checklist with owners and stronger disclosure rules; Output 2 loosens gates to $55 and $45.
Output 2 is closer to launch-ready with headlines, character counts, safe zones and a firm test rule; Output 1's cost-per-trip ad implies durability beyond the approved claims.
Output 1 has scene-level shot lists, spoken and on-screen disclosure, three angles with distinct proof and a fuller creator brief; Output 2 is thinner and its disclosure sits in the unsafe top zone.

Output 2 is genuinely submittable with samples, 8 templates including cancel and missed-delivery, a call script, agent capacity maths and a cart holdout; Output 1 leaves many bracket placeholders.
